title: CAIA® Charter (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst)
summary: The premier global benchmark in alternative investment education covering Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Commodities, and Structured Credit across Level I and Level II.

standard.name: Standard 2-Level Alternative Investment Pathway
standard.blurb: Complete Level I (200 MCQs, 4 Hours), Level II (100 MCQs + 3 Essay Vignettes, 4 Hours), and verify 1 year of alternative investment experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: CAIA Level I – Alternative Investment Fundamentals
stages.subtitle: Core asset classes, mechanics, and valuation models (200 MCQs | 4 Hours)

nodes.name: Level I Curriculum: Alternative Asset Classes
nodes.description: Professional standards, quantitative methods, introduction to alternative assets, real assets (real estate, infrastructure, natural resources), hedge funds, private equity, and structured products.
topics: Introduction to Alternative Investments & Quantitative Foundations (8-12%)
Real Assets: Real Estate, Infrastructure & Timber/Commodities (13-17%)
Hedge Funds: Equity Long/Short, Event-Driven, Macro & Arbitrage (13-17%)
Private Equity: Venture Capital, LBOs & Debt Restructuring (13-17%)
Structured Products: CDOs, Credit Derivatives & Securitization (13-17%)

nodes.name: CAIA Level I Examination Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing fundamental concepts, valuation models, and return characteristics of alternative asset classes. Note: Eligible CFA charterholders may qualify for the Stackable Credential Level I waiver.

stages.title: Stage 2: CAIA Level II – Advanced Core & Allocation
stages.subtitle: Portfolio allocation, due diligence, and constructed response essays

nodes.name: Level II Curriculum: Allocation, Risk & Due Diligence
nodes.description: Emerging topics, universal investment principles, asset allocation and institutional portfolio management, private equity and debt due diligence, hedge fund operational due diligence, and volatility/credit derivatives.
topics: Emerging Topics: ESG in Alternatives, Digital Assets & Decentralized Finance
Asset Allocation and Institutional Portfolio Management Frameworks
Operational Due Diligence (ODD) on Hedge Funds and Private Equity Managers
Advanced Risk Measurement: Liquidity Risk, Tail Risk & Factor Budgeting

nodes.name: CAIA Level II Examination Sitting
nodes.format: 100 Multiple-Choice Questions (Section 1) + 3 Constructed Response Essay Sets (Section 2)
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing application, synthesis, due diligence, and asset allocation across alternative asset classes.

stages.title: Stage 3: Professional Experience & Charterholder Induction
stages.subtitle: 1 Year Experience with Degree (or 4 Years without) + Ethics

nodes.name: 1 Year Qualifying Alternative Investment Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least one year of qualifying professional experience in alternative investment management, banking, consulting, or auditing (or 4 years without degree).

nodes.name: CAIA Charter Conferred & Membership
nodes.description: Admission as a full Member of the CAIA Association and authorization to use the CAIA® designation. Commitment to the CAIA Member Agreement and Code of Ethics.
